# nautobot_namespace (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a specific IPAM namespace in Nautobot by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nautobot_namespace" "global" {
  name = "Global"
}

output "global_namespace_id" {
  value = data.nautobot_namespace.global.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The exact name of the namespace to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Namespace creation date (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Namespace description.
- `display` (String) Human-friendly display value for the namespace.
- `id` (String) Namespace UUID.
- `last_updated` (String) Namespace last update date (RFC3339).
- `location_id` (String) UUID of the location associated with the namespace.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the namespace.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the namespace.
- `tenant_id` (String) UUID of the tenant associated with the namespace.
- `url` (String) API URL of the namespace.
